provider.description: Provider token owning this event; MUST equal reference.provider.

action.description: What happened to the review itself: submitted the verdict, edited it, or dismissed it.

state.description: The review verdict. A comment is not a review (it normalizes to mention/change_request); only a formal review carries a state.

text.description: The review body ('' when the reviewer submitted no comment).

commentId.description: Provider review id, when the provider exposes one (GitHub review id, GitLab discussion id).

headRef.description: Head branch of the reviewed change request, when the provider carries it.

payload.description: Verbatim provider event payload as received (audit + reconcile evidence).
